$comment: Python agent benchmark questions over the FastAPI, Flask and Django RealWorld backends and the Next.js frontend scanned with each of them: routes, callers, change impact, table users, env reads and frontend → Python backend requests. Expected answers were written by reading the pinned source (the @router / @blueprint.route / urls.py registrations, call sites of create_access_token_for_user, the SQL of the favorites queries and the comment functions, the settings and os.environ reads, the frontend's API calls), not from Concentrate output. Scoring as in questions.json.
